$comment: Endpoints mobile calls that Laravel does not serve, accepted temporarily.
This file exists so `npm run api:check` could become a blocking gate on the day
it was written instead of 'once the backlog is clear'. A gate deferred until the
- a new drift not listed here FAILS the check
- an entry that no longer drifts ALSO fails, with 'STALE BASELINE'
So a fix cannot land without deleting its entry, and the list cannot quietly
become a graveyard of forgotten breakage. Same contract as
Do NOT add an entry to make a red check green. Every addition is a member-facing
action that fails on a real phone.
